description: List all statistical data providers available on DBnomics — the unified gateway to 93+ national and international agencies. Includes IMF, World Bank (WB), OECD, Eurostat, ECB, BIS, UN, ILO, CEPII, and many more. Returns provider codes, full names, and regions. Use the returned provider codes with dbnomics.data.datasets to explore available datasets. DBnomics aggregates over 46,000 datasets and 1.7 billion time series from official statistical sources. No API key required — open data under CC-BY 4.0.

limit.description: Number of providers to return (1–200, default 100)

offset.description: Pagination offset — number of providers to skip (default 0)

name: dbnomics.data.providers

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: DBnomics — List Statistical Data Providers
